MoSoLab Lockdown

A 2–4 player co-op escape · get out before the Vacuumanator gets you

HOW TO PLAYEscape the lab together 🔬

  • 📝 Find the notes. Each note shows one digit of the Exit Lab code, and only whoever picked it up can see it (check your 🎒 Bag). Tell each other!
  • 🔒 Enter the code at the Exit Lab door. A wrong code sets off the alarm.
  • 🎚️ Pull every lever within 8 seconds of each other to power the exit gate, then everyone steps onto the green EXIT pad.
  • 🌀 Vacuumanator Proto hums when close and beeps when it spots you. Hide in lockers, throw a 🐥 decoy, or run back to the 🛡️ Safe Room.
  • 🗑️ Vacuumed? A teammate presses the red button at the Dust Bin Room to free you.
  • 🌑 Blackout Room (bigger floors): it's pitch dark inside. One player watches the 📹 night cam outside and taps to place guide markers, while the other finds the 🔌 fuse. Plug the fuse in next to the Exit Lab keypad to power it.
  • Roles: 🗺️ Momo has the map and drops decoys anywhere · 🦶 Soso kicks open stuck doors · 🌀 Kew crawls through vents · 😰 Bae senses Vacuumanators through walls.
